message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through the old backpack I used for camping trips. My grandkids were curious, of course, and they wanted to know what all the pockets were for. I explained that it was important to be ready for anything, whether it’s a fun adventure or an unexpected situation.

They giggled at my old granola bars and a flashlight that might have seen better days, but I could see the wheels turning in their little heads. We ended up having a great discussion about what we would need in case of a power outage or even just a rainy day at home.

It reminded me that preparedness doesn’t have to be daunting; it can be a family activity filled with laughter and learning. How do you share these moments with your family?
